title: SessionRequest
description: Body of POST /api/v1/sessions (permission request, FR-05/06/07). Mirrors SessionRequest in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Limits (LSP-1 sections 4.3.4 and 5): JSON body <= 256 KiB in the plaintext profile and <= 4 MiB (kMaxSessionJsonBytes) in the LSP/1.1 secure profile [I3], <= 10,000 files, every size >= 0 and sum(size) == totalSize. In the secure profile the request also carries a valid `X-LS-Auth` header and `sender.fingerprint` MUST equal the fingerprint it names (LSP-1 section 4.3.6). `sasCommit` [I3] is present iff the sender cannot authenticate the receiver (no pin). Unknown members MUST be ignored.

pin.description: Optional 6-digit PIN. Enforced from Increment 3; ignored before. Sent only after the receiver answered 401 PIN_REQUIRED.

sasCommit.description: [I3] SAS commitment: base64url (unpadded, exactly 43 characters = 32 bytes) of SHA-256("LSP1-SAS-C\0" || Ns || fpS || fpR), where Ns is the sender's 16-byte SAS nonce (revealed later by POST /sessions/{sid}/sas), fpS the sender's and fpR the receiver's certificate fingerprint as the sender saw it in the TLS handshake. Present iff the sender has no pin for the receiver. A receiver that gets a commitment never auto-accepts (LSP-1 section 5.1). Absent means: no SAS, sender authenticated the receiver by its pin.

chunkSize.description: Chunk size in bytes used for every chunk computation of this session. Default 4194304 (4 MiB). The Increment 1 receiver accepts only a power of two from 65536 (64 KiB) to 16777216 (16 MiB) and answers 400 BAD_REQUEST otherwise.

tunnelOffer.description: Present only when the sender pre-warmed an internet fallback (Increment 5).
